fileRejection.title: Ur yezmir ara ad yali ufaylu
fileRejection.multipleTitle: Ur zmiren ara ad alin {{count}} ifuyla
fileRejection.fileBlocked: Afaylu iḥbes ɣef lǧal n tɣellist
fileRejection.formatUnsupported: Tawsit n ufaylu ur tettwaqbal ara
fileRejection.executableDesc: I tɣellist n temkarit, ifuyla imselkamen (.exe, .sh, .bat, scripts) ur ttwaqbalen ara. Ttxil-k ssekcem ifuyla n tsekla neɣ tiwlafin.
fileRejection.polyglotDesc: Afaylu-agi yegber iskripten d ikuden ur nṣeḥḥa ara. Ttxil-k ssekcem lqem anasli.
fileRejection.extensionDesc: Afaylu-agi yesɛa aṭas n tsiɣzifin yettkellixen. Beddel isem n ufaylu s tsiɣzift tamezdayt.
fileRejection.zipBombDesc: Afaylu yettwaǧemmen ur iɛedda ara aselken n tɣellist. Ffeɣ ifuyla seg-s sakin ssekcem-iten yal wa i yiman-is.
fileRejection.sizeDesc: Teɣzi n ufaylu d {{size}}. Talast tafellayt d {{maxSize}}. Ttxil-k ssenqes deg teɣzi-ines neɣ fren afaylu nniḍen.
fileRejection.unsupportedDesc: Tawsit-agi ur tettwaqbal ara. Tewsatin yettwaqblen: PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, ZIP, JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4, MP3.
fileRejection.generalDesc: Teḍra-d tuccḍa ur nettwarǧi ara deg useddu n ufaylu. Ssenqed tuqqna-inek sakin ɛawed.
fileRejection.guidelinesDesc: Podacium tesselkay akk ifuyla i tɣellist mgal ifirusen. Nettqabal ifuyla n umahil (PDF, DOCX, XLSX), tiwlafin (JPEG, PNG, WEBP), isuddan (ZIP) d yisefka ddaw 100 MB. Ifuyla imselkamen ttwaḥebsen s wudem uzzig.
fileRejection.dataSheetsFormats: Tifelwiyin n isefka : CSV, XLSX, XLS, JSON, Parquet
fileRejection.imagesVisualsFormats: Tugniwin : JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP
fileRejection.mediaAudioFormats: Imedyaten d umeslaw : MP4, WebM, QuickTime (.mov), MP3, WAV
fileRejection.archivesFormats: Iḥrazen ZIP iḍemnen (ddaw 200 MA war asedres)
fileRejection.strictlyProhibitedDesc: Ifuyla imselkamen (.exe, .dll, .elf, .msi), iskripten (.sh, .bat, .cmd), d yifuyla n useqdec (.php, .phtml, .cgi) ttwagelzen s wudem awurman.
